metadata.description: ua-memory — put the shape of the codebase in front of the agent before it starts looking

plugins.name: ua-memory
plugins.description: Puts the codebase's layer map — what each layer is and which files are in it — into context at every session start, built from an Understand-Anything map and trimmed to fit Claude Code's 10,000-character hook limit. Adds a CLI for file, dependent and layer lookups.
